turns.input: Pellan gives Nicco a pair of leather boots.
turns.narration:
Pellan fumbles at his side and produces a worn pair of leather boots, extending them toward Nicco with ink-stained fingers. "Here. You need these more than I do." His voice carries the crack of someone who has rehearsed generosity to cover acute discomfort. "Walking around barefoot in Calderan—it's not done. People notice."

He does not withdraw the boots. His spectacles catch the daylight as he watches Nicco's reaction, anxious and plainly eager to be finished with whatever this exchange has become.

turns.input:
Thanks *he said to them, after which he decides to give them back the boots*
You'll need them more than me
turns.narration:
Nicco blinked down at the boots pressed into his hands. "Thanks," he said. He looked at them for a moment, then extended them back toward Pellan. "You'll need them more than me."

Pellan's ink-stained fingers froze mid-gesture. His spectacles caught the daylight as he tilted his head, mouth opening and closing silently before words found him. "I—this isn't—I don't require—" He stopped, took a shallow breath, and tried again with visible effort at composure. "You're refusing footwear. In Calderan. Where people *walk*." His voice rose slightly on the last word, a clerk's incredulity breaking through. "The streets are not—there is refuse, and horses, and the Watch doesn't—" He pressed one hand to his chest, visibly gathering himself. "Keep them. Please. As a favor. To my nerves."
